Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect suspend a different card from the one that's given "can't unsuspend until the end of their turn"?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card itself is played?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when a card digivolves into this card itself?

Effect: When this card would be played, by suspending 1 of your [WG] trait Digimon, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [WG] trait, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a [WG] trait Digimon card in the hand.
